opportunities.title: British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or research organisation; UK citizens or EEA nationals; must have completed doctorate between 1 Apr 2024‑1 Apr 2027 and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowship supporting independent research leading to a publishable output, funded at 80 % of salary costs under FEC.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term UK position; must be based in a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation; collaborative interdisciplinary projects across Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Up to 24‑month seed funding for interdisciplinary research addressing societal challenges, with up to £200k award value.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at any career stage based in the UK, from humanities or social sciences, proposing public‑engagement projects with a GLAM or performing‑arts partner.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects, up to £8,000, with support and community‑of‑practice workshops.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026‑27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers (postdoctoral or above) with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO; humanities or social sciences; must propose skill‑development projects.
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £10,000 for 6‑12 month periods to develop quantitative, digital, language or methodological skills.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in humanities or social sciences, with at least 20 % FTE on the project; must involve international co‑applicants and interdisciplinary collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Funding for 24‑month projects on mobilities, up to £300k (80 % FEC), covering staff, travel, fieldwork and networking costs.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships – DGAP 2026‑27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑ or mid‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences, based at a UK institution, interested in policy‑relevant work with DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: Two one‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP, up to £150k (80 % FEC), supporting research on security, Indo‑European relations, technology/AI, or strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027 (Alexander von Humboldt Foundation)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Funding for attendance at a three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature’, including travel, accommodation and seed funding for post‑symposium collaborations.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months; UK‑based.
opportunities.summary: One‑off support for specific additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility) up to £4,000.
